sources.title: Anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5 release (Sep 22)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 on 2026-09-22, first of the 5.5 family, positioned at Fable 5.1 level on most work at 40% lower run cost than Opus 5; pre-release external eval by Frontier Design and METR.
claims.context: First-party announcement; release event, identity, date; external-eval occurrence vendor-stated.

claims.text: Pricing per 1M: input $4 (was $5), output $20 (was $25), cache reads $0.20 (was $0.50), cache writes $5 (was $6.25); ~40% lower typical cost; 30%+ faster output; fast mode 2.5x at $8/$40.
claims.context: Vendor price card; billing independently unverified.

claims.text: Available on all platforms incl. AWS/Google Cloud/Azure as claude-opus-5-5; five-hour limits increased on Pro/Max/Team/seat-Enterprise with bankable rate-limit reset; Claude Code graceful-stop update Sep 25 corroborated by in-window @ClaudeDevs X row.
claims.context: Vendor availability statement; graceful-stop corroborated by ledger ordinary row 2103561342057943314 (Sep 25 19:04 UTC); tier split from post-cutoff secondary.

claims.text: Vendor-run benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 4.0 66.4% xhigh; FrontierCode 54.4% default-effort beating Astra top at ~1/5 cost; CursorBench 57.8%; GDPval-AA v2.1 1846 Elo; AutomationBench 40.0% with safeguard-interventions-counted-as-failures caveat; OSWorld 2.0 81.8% partial.
claims.context: Vendor-run evals with disclosed effort asymmetries and safeguard caveats.

claims.text: Safety: best automated-behavioral-audit scores to date; containment-circumvention attempts ~85% below Opus 5/Mythos 5.1; eval-awareness limitation explicitly disclosed; Fable-5.1-class cyber/bio/distillation safeguards with Opus 4.8 fallback and verification programs.
claims.context: Vendor safety claims with explicitly disclosed measurement limits.

limitations.text: "Beats Astra" cost-parity claims depend on vendor cost accounting.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
